english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person's disapproval or dissatisfied reaction.
This is the all-purpose noun for a feeling of dissatisfaction or disapproval.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for a person's unhappiness or discontent.
Use this when the remonstrance mainly expresses dissatisfaction or grumbling rather than an explicit protest.
Use this for dissatisfaction or a grievance toward a person or thing.
